items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013

ctx.x: Well because of the assumption theory. The up and coming blacks assume they got it. They don’t have it. They assume it’s a given. Well we know that. The only thing that stopped me from being an expert reader, which I am not and I don’t know anybody who is, unless it’s Jon Faddis. I didn’t have the money to study. If I had the money to study I would have been the Wynton Marsalis of the sixties. Now I had one guy that wanted to teach me, he had a car accident and became really disabled. See it’s opportunity meets…
No one ever accused you of being shy.
